name: capcut_generate_preview
description: Renders a fast proxy preview video (.mp4) of a CapCut project using ffmpeg without needing to export from the GUI.

fps.description: Render framerate (defaults to project fps, e.g. 30).

height.description: Custom render height (defaults to project canvas height).

output_path.description: Optional custom destination path for the rendered mp4.

width.description: Custom render width (defaults to project canvas width).
